Prompts.CCCD:
Analyze this Vietnamese Citizen Identity Card (CCCD) image and extract the following information:
- citizenId: 12-digit identification number
- fullName: Full name in UPPERCASE Vietnamese (as shown on the card)
- dateOfBirth: Date of birth in format DD/MM/YYYY

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "citizenId": "string",
  "fullName": "string",
  "dateOfBirth": "string"
}

If any field cannot be read clearly, set it to null.
IMPORTANT: If any field is obscured, partially hidden, or cannot be read clearly, DO NOT guess or infer the value. Only return the value if you can read all digits/characters clearly from the image.
Do not include any explanations or additional text, only the JSON object.
Prompts.TOEIC:
Analyze this TOEIC certificate image and extract the following information:
- certificateType: Should be 'TOEIC' (confirm this is a TOEIC certificate)
- citizenId: 12-digit Vietnamese Citizen ID (if present on certificate)
- fullName: Candidate's full name in UPPERCASE
- dateOfBirth: Date of birth in format DD/MM/YYYY (if present)
- testDate: Test date in format YYYY/MM/DD
- validUntil: Certificate expiry date in format YYYY/MM/DD
- listeningScore: Listening section score (0-495)
- readingScore: Reading section score (0-495)
- totalScore: Total score (0-990)

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "certificateType": "string",
  "citizenId": "string",
  "fullName": "string",
  "dateOfBirth": "string",
  "testDate": "string",
  "validUntil": "string",
  "listeningScore": 0,
  "readingScore": 0,
  "totalScore": 0
}

If any field cannot be read clearly, set it to null (for strings) or 0 (for numbers).
IMPORTANT: If any field is obscured, partially hidden, or cannot be read clearly, DO NOT guess or infer the value. For string fields, return null. For number fields (scores), return 0. Only return the value if you can read all digits/characters clearly from the image.
Do not include any explanations or additional text, only the JSON object.
